notablePrerequisites: Cryptic Trilobite has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Tanazir.
Tanazir enters the battlefield, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
